integrity: The all-n proof conditions on a single adjacent descent and computes the induced two-position mean shift exactly. Exhaustive permutation enumeration and a separate exact conditional-pair calculation are supplementary checks only.
scientific_limitations: The formulas assume a uniform random permutation and complete rankings without ties.
The result is a null-distribution dependence identity rather than a comparison of power under alternatives.
An equivalent covariance may exist in older unindexed permutation-statistics literature under different notation.
title: Uniform local descent covariance with Spearman's rho
